{"individuals": [
{"title": "Wikimedia Enterprise", "class": "business.product", "quote": "**Wikimedia Enterprise** is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation available via enterprise.wikimedia.com."},
{"title": "Wikimedia Foundation", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "Given the nature of the service, primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation."},
{"title": "enterprise.wikimedia.com", "class": "business.businessinterface", "quote": "**Wikimedia Enterprise** is a service of the Wikimedia Foundation available via enterprise.wikimedia.com."},
{"title": "Build services for high-volume commercial reusers", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "The goal of the service is to build services for high-volume commercial reusers of Wikimedia content."},
{"title": "Service announced March 2021", "class": "business.businessevent", "quote": "The service was announced in March 2021 (blogpost, WIRED article)"},
{"title": "Service launched October 2021", "class": "product.milestone", "quote": "launched in October 2021 (Press release, OpenFutures article)"},
{"title": "Improve user experience of readers beyond own websites", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "Wikimedia Enterprise aims to improve the user experience of Wikimedia's readers beyond our own websites"},
{"title": "Increase reach and discoverability of content", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "increase the reach and discoverability of the content"},
{"title": "Improve attribution and verifiability awareness among reusers", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "improve awareness and ease of attribution and verifiability by the organizations that reuse Wikimedia project data the most—through self-funding services"},
{"title": "High barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "There is a very high barrier to entry for using Wikimedia data, outside of the common use cases of reading or editing. This is because the content is hard for machines to segment and understand"},
{"title": "Movement Strategy recommendations", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "the Movement Strategy recommendations (2020) represent the culmination of wide-ranging consultation across the Wikimedia community and stakeholders about our future"},
{"title": "Massive companies benefit without reinvesting", "class": "motivation.driver", "quote": "There has long been a feeling among community members that these companies should do more to reinvest in the Wikimedia communities for the benefits they gain from the content and resources they use."},
{"title": "Clearer, more sustainable relationship with enterprise users", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "developing a new approach that is more sustainable in the long term and provides a much clearer relationship between Wikimedia and enterprise users"},
{"title": "Financial benefit mostly from few heavy for-profit users", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Most financial benefit for Wikimedia would likely only come from a very small handful of heavy for-profit users, and would feed back into the Wikimedia movement."},
{"title": "Democratize data for less-resourced organizations", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "there is a responsibility to democratize our data for organizations that do not possess the resources of these largest users, to ensure we are leveling the playing field and helping to foster a healthy internet without reinforcing monopolies"},
{"title": "High-volume commercial reusers", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "Wikimedia Enterprise's focus is on businesses that reuse our content, typically at a large scale"},
{"title": "Universities and university researchers", "class": "motivation.stakeholder", "quote": "but also for universities and university researchers; archives and archivists; along with the wider Wikimedia movement"},
{"title": "Frequency", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**Frequency**: Regular current snapshots of Wikimedia projects"},
{"title": "Reliability", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**Reliability**: Dependable, accessible infrastructure"},
{"title": "Quality", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**Quality**: a “best last revision”"},
{"title": "Community editing tools out of scope", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "This includes the majority of community editing tools, which will be out of scope for this service."},
{"title": "Content program goal", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "**Content**: Make more of our movement's content available in consistent machine-readable formats, freely available for all researchers and re-users."},
{"title": "Resource-load program goal", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "**Resource-load**: Reduce the need for high-intensity site-scraping by the highest-frequency and highest-volume reusers, which currently target our production servers."},
{"title": "Fundraising program goal", "class": "motivation.goal", "quote": "**Fundraising**: Provide a clearer and more consistent way for the largest re-users to reinvest derived benefits back to the movement, instead of making occasional altruistic donations that vary in size."},
{"title": "Wikimedia projects always remain libre", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "Wikimedia projects are, have always been, and will always remain *libre*. The principles of free cultural works mean that anyone can use Wikimedia without restriction, including commercially."},
{"title": "Reject non-commercial licenses", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "It is why we reject ‘non-commercial’ licenses, as they would limit the kinds of reuse possible."},
{"title": "Wikimedia projects always remain gratis", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "The full corpus of Wikimedia content always has been, and will continue to be, made available for reuse in various forms (including but not limited to database dumps, APIs, and scraping) at no cost."},
{"title": "Movement never received benefits from reuser revenue", "class": "motivation.assessment", "quote": "Outside of voluntary corporate donations to the Wikimedia Foundation, the movement has never received benefits from any of this revenue through return investment."},
{"title": "Avoid revenue dependencies and undue external influence", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "taking care to avoid revenue dependencies or other undue external influence in product design and development"},
{"title": "Enterprise offering not required for commercial reuse", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "Use of this offering will not be required for for-profit content reuse; companies can continue to use the current tools available at no cost."},
{"title": "All Enterprise API revenue supports Wikimedia mission", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "All Enterprise API revenue will unequivocally be used to support the Wikimedia mission—for example, to fund Wikimedia programs or help grow the Wikimedia Endowment."},
{"title": "Commitment to listening and integrating feedback", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "The team is committed to listening, engaging, and where possible, integrating the feedback we get on our work."},
{"title": "Primary decision making rests with WMF", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "Given the nature of the service, primary decision making for it will rest with the Wikimedia Foundation."},
{"title": "Paid access for large commercial organisations", "class": "business.businessservice", "quote": "The *primary* use case of the suite of Enterprise APIs is paid access for large commercial organisations, with associated Service Level Agreements and dedicated customer support."},
{"title": "Access for all", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "in accordance with the project's principle of *access for all*, there are also various ways to access the Wikimedia Enterprise APIs for free"},
{"title": "Free account", "class": "business.businessservice", "quote": "Creating a free account on the official website and using the Enterprise API access for free accounts."},
{"title": "PAWS", "class": "technology.node", "quote": "You get the same access as a paid account when making a call to any Enterprise API endpoint from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge."},
{"title": "Wikimedia Cloud VPS", "class": "technology.node", "quote": "from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge"},
{"title": "Toolforge", "class": "technology.node", "quote": "from within PAWS, Wikimedia Cloud VPS, or Toolforge"},
{"title": "Structured Contents (beta) datasets", "class": "technology.artifact", "quote": "Downloading Structured Contents (beta) datasets hosted on third-party platforms."},
{"title": "Exceptional access", "class": "business.businessservice", "quote": "you may request free **exceptional access** to the higher rate of the Enterprise APIs"},
{"title": "Exceptional access request review", "class": "business.businessprocess", "quote": "Requests will be reviewed by *Wikimedia Foundation* staff in accordance with the following criteria, and granted at the Wikimedia Foundation's discretion."},
{"title": "Wikimedia Deutschland", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "If the request includes substantive access to *Wikidata* content, the request will be reviewed in coordination with staff from *Wikimedia Deutschland*."},
{"title": "Who criterion", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**1. Who** (individual or organisation) is requesting exceptional access? Please list the contact person’s name, organisation (if applicable), email address, and *Enterprise* API account username."},
{"title": "What criterion", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**2. What** is the request for? Please specify what specific exception is being requested, and for what purpose."},
{"title": "Must abide by copyright licenses", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "All users of Wikimedia Enterprise services must abide by the copyright licenses on Wikimedia content. They are inherent and cannot be waived."},
{"title": "Need criterion", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**3. Need**. Can the intended use-case be fulfilled via any of the existing free access methods?"},
{"title": "Exceptional access only after standard options exhausted", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "Exceptional free access to a paid account can only be granted when all standard options are exhausted – including the free account of the Enterprise services."},
{"title": "Obligation criterion", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**4. Obligation.** Would the intended use case require custom development to support or maintain? What is the duration of the requested exception?"},
{"title": "Non-exclusivity: new features available to all", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "In accordance with the Wikimedia Enterprise operating principles regarding non-exclusivity, any newly developed software feature or dataset must be made available to all."},
{"title": "Mission alignment criterion", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**5. Mission alignment**. Is the intended use case aligned with any of the needs identified in the Movement Strategy Recommendations?"},
{"title": "Special consideration for marginalized communities", "class": "motivation.principle", "quote": "Special consideration would be given to organizations serving marginalized communities, underrepresented languages, or Wikimedia sister projects."},
{"title": "No closed knowledge silos or proprietary forks", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "The proposed use-case should not deliberately create or reinforce closed knowledge silos, proprietary forks of the content, or circumvent community norms or policies."},
{"title": "Values alignment criterion", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "**6. Values alignment**. Do the requester’s professional practices or business model align with Wikimedia’s values?"},
{"title": "Human rights assessment", "class": "business.businessprocess", "quote": "A human rights assessment is undertaken by the WMF for certain users of paid accounts for the Enterprise APIs (regardless of payment or exceptional access)"},
{"title": "Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy", "class": "motivation.constraint", "quote": "The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees as described on the *Wikimedia Foundation Commercial Sales and Contracts Policy*."},
{"title": "Demonstrate commitment to open knowledge", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "in order to receive free access to a paid account, the user should also be able to demonstrate a commitment to open knowledge, transparency, and/or public-benefit mission"},
{"title": "Business model not in conflict with Wikimedia values", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "The business-model should at the very least not be in conflict with Wikimedia’s values"},
{"title": "Snapshot API", "class": "application.applicationservice", "quote": "The Enterprise Snapshot API allows users to retrieve entire Wikimedia projects as a database dump file."},
{"title": "On-demand API", "class": "application.applicationservice", "quote": "The Wikimedia Enterprise On-demand API allows users to retrieve single articles from any supported Wikimedia project at anytime."},
{"title": "Realtime API", "class": "application.applicationservice", "quote": "The Enterprise Realtime API allows users to stream updates in real-time from any supported Wikimedia project."},
{"title": "Structured JSON response format", "class": "application.dataobject", "quote": "All of our APIs return the same structured JSON (or ND-JSON) response format making it easy to augment one API with another."},
{"title": "Article data payload", "class": "application.dataobject", "quote": "API responses payloads include article data such as summary, image, Wikidata QID, license, and metadata specific to the last revision such as editor, size of change, and credibility score with revert probability."},
{"title": "Data Dictionary", "class": "technology.artifact", "quote": "All data fields and schema are explained in detail on the project's Data Dictionary website page."},
{"title": "Compressed dumps updated monthly/weekly/daily", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Compressed dumps (in both wikitext and HTML) of supported text-based Wikimedia projects, updated monthly on a free account and weekly or daily on a paid account"},
{"title": "Wikimedia Dumps", "class": "technology.artifact", "quote": "For high-volume reusers that currently rely on the Wikimedia Dumps to access our information"},
{"title": "EventStream platform", "class": "technology.technologyservice", "quote": "Reusers that use an infrastructure reliant on the EventStream platform depend on services like RESTBase to pull HTML from page titles and current revisions"},
{"title": "RESTBase", "class": "technology.technologyservice", "quote": "depend on services like RESTBase to pull HTML from page titles and current revisions to update their products"},
{"title": "Filter changes to limit processing", "class": "motivation.requirement", "quote": "High-volume reusers are interested in a service that will allow them to filter the changes they receive to limit their processing, guarantee stable HTTP connections to ensure no data loss"},
{"title": "Streaming firehose updates", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Streaming: Receive streaming (firehose) updates of every change as they occur in real-time"},
{"title": "Hourly batch files", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Batch: Download compressed files of all articles that were changed, generated hourly"},
{"title": "Filtering of events by Project or Namespace", "class": "product.feature", "quote": "Filtering of events by Project or Revision Namespace"},
{"title": "99% SLA for contracted accounts", "class": "business.contract", "quote": "Contracted accounts receive 99% SLA and support response-time guarantees."},
{"title": "Commercial Partnerships", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "The Wikimedia Enterprise project is helmed by the **Commercial Partnerships** division, which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation."},
{"title": "Advancement Department", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "which sits under the Advancement Department in the Wikimedia Foundation"},
{"title": "Technical Partnerships team", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "to reflect the inclusion of the Technical Partnerships team"},
{"title": "Division renamed to Commercial Partnerships", "class": "business.businessevent", "quote": "Since December 2025, the division working on the Wikimedia Enterprise Initiative changed its name from 'Wikimedia Enterprise' to 'Commercial Partnerships'"},
{"title": "PartnerHero", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "**PartnerHero** provide customer support services"},
{"title": "Vuurr", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "**Vuurr** are assisting our sales process"},
{"title": "Super Natural Design", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "**Super Natural Design** are the designers of the project website"},
{"title": "Perrine Winkler", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "**Perrine Winkler** has been contracted to help with rebranding the team behind Enterprise to Commercial Partnerships"},
{"title": "Speed & Function", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "Engineering support was provided in the first years by **Speed & Function**."},
{"title": "LLC board", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "The board of the LLC overseeing the project are *Ex officio* from Wikimedia Foundation leadership, representing their Wikimedia Foundation staff roles."},
{"title": "Sheetal Puri", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "This includes the Chief Advancement Officer Sheetal Puri"},
{"title": "Chief Advancement Officer", "class": "business.businessrole", "quote": "This includes the Chief Advancement Officer Sheetal Puri"},
{"title": "Stephen LaPorte", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "General Counsel Stephen LaPorte"},
{"title": "General Counsel", "class": "business.businessrole", "quote": "General Counsel Stephen LaPorte"},
{"title": "Selena Deckelman", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "Chief Product and Technology Officer Selena Deckelman"},
{"title": "Chief Product and Technology Officer", "class": "business.businessrole", "quote": "Chief Product and Technology Officer Selena Deckelman"},
{"title": "Lane Becker", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "Lane Becker who serves as the LLC's president"},
{"title": "LLC president", "class": "business.businessrole", "quote": "Lane Becker who serves as the LLC's president"},
{"title": "Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees", "class": "business.businessactor", "quote": "The LLC is subject to the governance of the Wikimedia Foundation Board of Trustees"},
{"title": "Wikimedia Foundation Governance website", "class": "business.businessinterface", "quote": "All reports and official documents of the LLC are published on a dedicated Wikimedia Enterprise page on the **Wikimedia Foundation Governance** website."}
]}
